messages:
maria: quick q — I'm updating the Quickstart HelloApp to prefer REDWOOD_KEY and tighten first-deploy steps. coordinating docs + example app + sdk snippet PRs. Drafts: https://github.com/redwood/quickstart/pull/487 (WIP) and https://github.com/redwood/sdk-js/pull/210 (snippets)

devon: SG. i'll take SDK snippet. do we want a fallback to REDWOOD_API_KEY for backward compat?

maria: yes, keep fallback. suggested node snippet:
```js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwoodai/sdk';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY || process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const out = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood/ft-1', prompt: 'Hello world' });
console.log(out.text);
```

devon: i'll also update curl. proposed curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/ft-1","prompt":"Hi"}'
```

lila: i'll update quickstart .env.sample and README. found a broken internal link pointing to /docs/old-quickstart-path — swapping to /docs/quickstart/helloapp and adding anchor checks.

sachin: add migration blurb: "REDWOOD_API_KEY still works; we recommend REDWOOD_KEY going forward." also add note on token scopes (read/generate).

maria: add note near deploy: "Create a token in Console > API tokens and paste into .env (use REDWOOD_KEY)." include a 1200px wide blurred token screenshot.

devon: i'll add a small jest test in sdk/examples asserting Authorization header set to `Bearer <token>` using mock fetch.

lila: pushed .env.sample update and screenshot tweak (1200w compressed).

docs-bot: preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-487--docs.redwood.ai (quickstart) ✅

devon: reviewed SDK PR, left a nit about named exports. changed to `RedwoodClient` named import in PR.

sachin: LGTM. security nit: blur tokens in screenshots.

maria: added CHANGELOG entry: "docs: quickstart prefer REDWOOD_KEY; preserve REDWOOD_API_KEY fallback". opening follow-up for CLI token example.

lila: assigning reviewers @devon @sachin. merging once both previews green.

devon: approved SDK PR; added jest mock test. will merge after quickstart preview.

maria: merged both. follow-up: add a plain‑English note for non-dev users on where to find Console tokens.

sachin: optional: add rotation + KMS blurb for enterprise customers.

maria: noted. closing thread. thanks :tada:
